title: Restore records-history design and accepted decision D111
summary: Re-land the archived records-history design (docs/design/records-history.md), its accepted decision entry renumbered from D112 to D111, and its two CHANGELOG entries, taken from archive/next4-2026-10-23. Spec-job material (archived D111, spec.toml, ontology.toml, enforcement.md) is left out. The audience is Sri and the verifier, who compare the text with the archive.

defaults_applied.how: Docs-only change limited to three files.
Independent diff comparison against the archive.
Text kept as archived, written for outside readers.
Criteria compare the final text against the archive and check the numbering.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: The archive branch is readable with git show, and its design text is final (verified twice).
D111 is free here: decisions.md currently ends at D110.
Differences in branch state are limited to things like decision numbers, the CHANGELOG position, and references to files or decisions that were left out (the spec job's).

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/design/records-history.md matches `git show archive/next4-2026-10-23:docs/design/records-history.md` except that every D112 is now D111 and any state that differs on this branch is adjusted; the diff against the archive shows only those changes.

docs/decisions.md has a new entry headed D111 (the next free number after D110, placed after it), with the archived D112 text, status accepted, citing the BRIEF.md addenda of 2026-10-23. It has no D112 entry and does not contain the archived spec job's D111.
The design contains no remaining reference to D112, and each D111 reference in it points to the records-history decision.

CHANGELOG.md has the archive's two entries for the records-history design and decision under [Unreleased]. Their wording is unchanged except that D112 becomes D111. There are no entries for the spec job.
Only docs/design/records-history.md, docs/decisions.md and CHANGELOG.md change. docs/spec.toml, docs/ontology.toml and docs/enforcement.md are absent or unchanged.
Run `git diff --stat` and `git status` to confirm that exactly the three paths changed. Run `git diff` to check the D111 renumbering and the absence of spec-job content.

out_of_scope: Restoring the spec job's D111, docs/spec.toml, docs/ontology.toml or docs/enforcement.md
Any code, athena.toml or workflow changes
Implementing the records branch or the build plan
departures: Mechanical restore from a known verified text, so slightly higher pass odds than the reference. The risks are missed D112 references and archive text that mentions the spec job.
